Warm hello gate team,
The gate agent sent an update on treat supplies.

Please keep the current stock checked at the desk and hand off any shortfall notes at once. I am logging this because the Companion Animal Travel Desk needs a clean record for every handoff, especially when travelers are already tense at the gate. If Mei Rossi or Diego Wilson comes through with a pet crate issue, stay calm and pass the details to the senior coordinator without delay. <<FACT F078>> Use the standard intake path and keep the carrier notes with the file so the next team can see the full picture.

I also need a quick count of any spare comfort items, labels, and cleanup supplies before the next arrival wave. <<FACT F064>> If Winnie is mentioned in any handover, check the paperwork against the booking record and make sure the crate tag, route notes, and handling notes match exactly. We are seeing more worried calls than usual, and the supervisors are asking for careful listening and clear logging from all gate staff. Any mismatch in the pet file should be reported right away so we can correct it before boarding.

Please treat this as urgent and keep your notes brief but complete. The department coordinates care from booking through pickup, and the record trail has to stay steady even when the line is busy. Thank you for the fast follow-through and for keeping the travelers informed without adding extra delay.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
